align.description: an item pronounces on settledness instead of describing — 'settled', 'finalized', 'canon', or the inverse hedges ('deliberately open', 'expected to evolve', 'not dictated here'); the doctrine is specificity-per-confidence: describe the shape at the specificity current understanding supports, and leave flux unstated — it is the ambient condition of everything here, so restating it in either direction adds status where only description belongs
